1084-4279-5332.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-5332.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-5332.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2595-4694-6797-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4694-6797-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-4694-6797-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

728-1981-2415-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-6097.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

620-1429-1477.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

553-1470-5858.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Gandalf.
In response, cast Hinder by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

1799-2034-3862-7654.easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
1799-2034-3862-7654.notablePrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
1799-2034-3862-7654.description:
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Army and Orcish Bowmasters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6441-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1169-1563-3129-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2438-5702-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

934-3053-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
934-3053-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2999-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-4186-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-3951-5703-5929.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
2557-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

813-2955-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Justiciar's Portal.
813-2955-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

144-628-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Repeat.

974-1350-5847.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Caretaker's Talent is level 1.
974-1350-5847.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Caretaker's Talent's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Caretaker's Talent by paying {W}, putting a level counter on it.
Caretaker's Talent's second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died triggers, and Caretaker's Talent's first ability triggers if it hasn't yet triggered this turn.
Resolve the Caretaker's Talent trigger, if applicable, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Caretaker's Talent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Caretaker's Talent by paying {2}{W}.
Repeat from step 4.

2173-2438-3025-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4952-5003-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
4952-5003-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Darksteel Splicer, adding {R}.
When Darksteel Splicer dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Darksteel Splicer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Darksteel Splicer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least one 3/3 Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Phyrexian Golems, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
If you have four or more opponents, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and red mana.

501-678-5284.description:
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Blood Vassal dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Blood Vassal from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Blood Vassal by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1810-2743-3024.description:
Cast Complete the Circuit by paying {5}{U}, causing you to copy the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Complete the Circuit triggers, copying Cackling Counterpart twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Cackling Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

618-2085.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Kelpie Guide with haste.
Activate Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, causing you to sacrifice all Kelpie Guide tokens.
